## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] Ran `pytest`, `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, and `mypy`.
- [ ] Updated documentation, changelog, or release notes when needed.
- [ ] Checked that no secrets, personal data, or private repository paths are included.

## Compatibility

- [ ] This preserves the documented instruction-loader model, or the upstream
      reference and compatibility documentation have been updated together.
